import pytest

MODULE_PATH = 'browser_use.observability'

def reload_observability():

        del importlib.sys.modules[MODULE_PATH]

def test_debug_mode_via_env_vars(monkeypatch):
    # No debug vars set -> should be False
    monkeypatch.delenv('LMNR_LOGGING_LEVEL', raising=False)
    monkeypatch.delenv('DEBUG', raising=False)
    monkeypatch.delenv('BROWSER_USE_DEBUG', raising=False)
    obs = reload_observability()
    assert not obs.is_debug_mode()

    # Set DEBUG env var to true -> should be True
    monkeypatch.setenv('DEBUG', 'true')
    obs = reload_observability()
    assert obs.is_debug_mode()

    # Unset DEBUG, set BROWSER_USE_DEBUG to 1 -> should be True
    monkeypatch.delenv('DEBUG', raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv('BROWSER_USE_DEBUG', '1')

    obs = reload_observability()
    assert obs.is_debug_mode()
